objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction or work instruction subject to lifecycle management including creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language of the document content.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which an invalidated document is retained before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Period after which validity must be re-checked (default 3 years).

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled supplementary document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment within the release process of the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary information object linked to a document that is not subject to a release cycle and can be published directly via property switches.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Published or unpublished state of the additional information.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until implemented.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the validity extension request.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document and archive it, created by a user with write access when a document has no additional validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the override request.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, created exclusively by the Business Admin group.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the reactivation request.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning read or change authorizations to documents.

attributes.name: group_name
attributes.description: Name of the user group (e.g. Reader, Authors, Reviewer, Releaser, Archive).

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser or translator on a document.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role assigned to the person on a specific document (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document that controls email notification, acknowledgement requests and dashboard visibility upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by email or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance guiding documents through the steps of creation, review and release or other approval processes.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current step in the workflow (e.g. Creator, Review, Release).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the workflow (e.g. active, completed, cancelled).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who provided the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the signature was provided.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document is created in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type of document being created.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected for the new document.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding local Office component.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: The properties and metadata of a document are maintained or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: A saved document is automatically converted to PDF format and displayed on the web.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: complete_review
evts.description: A reviewer completes the review step by confirming the technical or formal check of the document.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Whether the review is technical or formal.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Positive or negative outcome of the review.

evts.name: complete_release
evts.description: A releaser completes the release step, approving the document for distribution.

attributes.name: result
attributes.description: Positive or negative outcome of the release decision.

evts.name: reject_in_review
evts.description: A reviewer rejects the document during the review step, cancelling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: reject_in_release
evts.description: A releaser rejects the document during the release step, cancelling the workflow for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: A released document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when the document is revised or when attachments are modified.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: Reason for the new version (content change, attachment change, change proposal implementation, reactivation).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: The content of an existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is created and linked to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is deleted from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is marked as completed by the author after editing.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser or release participants confirm the document's continued validity, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The override process is completed and the document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: The Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms the reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups maintained for acknowledgement on the distribution list are requested by email to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the released document version via a workflow-supported task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a document.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization (read, write).

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: The released content of a document is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language the document is translated into.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released with workflow support.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file is uploaded to an object cover in DHC VISION.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: A document is physically deleted from the system after the archive period has expired.
